lines: A cold spring bubbles up between the stones.

sign: Grey roots, thick as arms. Nothing grows on them.

lines: A grey root knot. Rub it, and it could turn green.
A grey root knot. Rub it, and it could turn red.
A grey root knot. Rub it, and it could turn yellow.

hint: Painted by a dyer: madder red, then weld yellow, then woad green.

lines: Kestra: There you are. Tatter wouldn't stop pulling me here.
Kestra: Hushed Wanderers block the roots. Two of us, two of them?

kestra_after: Kestra: Go on in. I'll keep the mouth clear behind you.
kestra_tag_defeat: The Wanderers shake the grey dust from their coats.
Kestra: Side by side again. I could get used to this.
kestra_tag_lose: Kestra: The roots won this round. Rest, then we try again.
wen: Wen: Darrow pulls up every sprout. Says it only fades anyway.
wen_intro: Wen: You want to reach him? Through my roots first.
wen_defeat: Wen: Maybe you can make him look at a leaf again.
corm: Corm: I dig peat. Down here the peat digs back.
corm_intro: Corm: Watch your step. And your Spirlings.
corm_defeat: Corm: Deep roots, that one. Like you.
tilde: Tilde: The roots remember their colours. You only have to remind them.
tilde_intro: Tilde: Let's see what grows in you.
tilde_defeat: Tilde: A lot, it seems. Go to Darrow.

lines: Darrow: Nothing grows here. Nothing should. It all fades.
Darrow: Green, under the grey. I'd forgotten green was a colour.
Darrow: This crystal holds a root's grip. Hold on to what grows.
Darrow: I planted a garden by the moor. Weeds and all.

darrow_intro: Darrow: Every leaf in Corvane went grey. Why grow new ones?
Darrow: Turn back. Or let my roots hold you here.
darrow_defeat: Darrow: ...My Thornback is flowering. In the middle of the Fading.
Darrow: Maybe things should grow after all. Help me close it.
